failures.title: Admin approve_claim action missing post_author transfer and meta
failures.detail: Admin page approve_claim action in class-admin.php only calls $wpdb->update(status='approved'). Missing: wp_update_post(post_author), update_post_meta(_listora_is_claimed, true), do_action(wb_listora_listing_claimed). Full logic only exists in REST endpoint class-claims-controller.php. Listing ownership not transferred when approved from admin UI.

failures.title: wb_listora_pro_expire_needs uses WP-Cron not Action Scheduler
failures.detail: wb_listora_pro_expire_needs uses wp_schedule_event() (WP-Cron) instead of Action Scheduler. Other Pro cron jobs correctly use AS.

failures.title: min_rating URL param not seeded into IAPI state.filters on page reload
failures.detail: listing-search/render.php seeds selectedCategory, selectedLocation, selectedType, sortBy into wp_interactivity_state() but NOT min_rating. On reload with ?min_rating=2, state.activeFilterCount shows 1 instead of 2. Badge miscounts active filters after reload.

failures.title: Login modal markup missing in listing-detail/render.php for anonymous toggleFavorite
failures.detail: IAPI store toggleFavorite() sets state.activeModal='login' for anon users but no DOM element in listing-detail/render.php is bound to state.isLoginModalOpen. Anon user clicking Save/Favorite gets no feedback — silent failure.

failures.title: Search suggestions dropdown never populates — two compounding bugs
failures.detail: (a) setSearchQuery calls actions.search() (full debounced search) but never calls actions.fetchSuggestions() — suggestions dropdown never populates on typing. (b) fetchSuggestions() sends ?keyword=X but endpoint requires ?q=X — returns HTTP 400.

failures.title: Geo distance display requires Google Places API key (not configured in local dev)
failures.detail: Haversine distance requires geocoded origin coordinates from Google Places API. No API key configured in local dev environment — expected skip.

failures.title: AS jobs orphaned when feature toggle disabled — 'no callbacks registered' failures
failures.detail: advanced_search toggle is OFF (b:0). Feature_Manager skips Advanced_Search::init() so add_action(ALERT_HOOK) never runs. But wb_listora_pro_saved_search_alerts AS jobs are still scheduled → fire and fail with 'no callbacks registered'. DB shows 3 failed runs. Feature toggle save should cancel/reschedule related AS jobs.
failures.db_evidence: wp_actionscheduler_actions: 3 failed runs of wb_listora_pro_saved_search_alerts, 3 failed runs of wb_listora_pro_analytics_cleanup

failures.title: Favorite buttons missing aria-label after IAPI hydration
failures.detail: listora-favorite-btn has data-wp-bind--aria-label binding but after IAPI hydration aria-label remains null on the DOM element. Button has textContent '1' (favorite count) which is not accessible. Screen readers cannot identify the button purpose.

known_spec_deltas.delta: Stat labels in spec (Listings/Reviews/Claims/Favourites) differ from implementation (Active/Pending/Reviews/Saved). Transient key in spec (listora_dash_stats_{id}) differs from implementation (listora_dashboard_stats_{id}). No claims stat — by design.
CSS class .listora-claim-row in spec, actual is .listora-dashboard__claim-row. Badge label 'Pending' → 'Under review'.
Email log is wp_options rolling array (wb_listora_notification_log), not DB table. Hook has 3 args not 4. Log entry has event_key/recipient/subject/success, no listing_id.
Capabilities namespace is WBListora\Core\Capabilities not WBListora\Capabilities. Methods are can_*() not has_cap().
